doc: Comprehensive tagging system for objects across modules

endp.mgtags.list.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tags from the database. Results can be filtered by category and active status, and ordered by various fields.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tags to return (1-100, default 20)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Starting row for pagination (0+, default 0)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional category filter

parameters.name: active_only
parameters.description: Whether to include only active tags

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Field to order by: name, created, updated, weight

parameters.name: order_direction
parameters.description: Sort direction: asc or desc

endp.mgtags.add.short_descr: Add a new tag to the system
endp.mgtags.add.description: Creates a new tag with the provided information. If no slug is provided, it will be auto-generated from the tag name by converting to lowercase, replacing spaces with dashes, and removing non-alphanumeric characters.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Required tag name (min 1 character)

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Optional URL-friendly slug (auto-generated if not provided)

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional tag description

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Optional hex color code (must be valid 6-digit hex)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional tag category for organization

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Tag weight for relevance calculations (0-10, default 1.0)

endp.mgtags.obj.add.short_descr: Assign a tag to an object
endp.mgtags.obj.add.description: Creates a tag assignment relationship between a tag (identified by slug) and an object (identified by module and object ID). The assignment includes a relevance score and metadata about who created it and when.

parameters.name: tag_slug
parameters.description: Required tag slug to identify the tag

parameters.name: id_object
parameters.description: Required object identifier

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Required module name that owns the object

parameters.name: relevance
parameters.description: Relevance score between 0 and 1 (default 1.0)

parameters.name: auto_tagged
parameters.description: Whether tag was auto-assigned (default false)

endp.mgtags.obj.del.short_descr: Remove a tag from an object
endp.mgtags.obj.del.description: Deletes the relationship between a tag and an object, effectively untagging the object. The tag itself remains in the system.

parameters.name: tag_slug
parameters.description: Required tag slug to identify the tag to remove

parameters.name: id_object
parameters.description: Required object identifier

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Required module name that owns the object

endp.mgtags.obj.list.short_descr: Get all tags assigned to an object
endp.mgtags.obj.list.description: Returns a list of all tags associated with an object, including tag details and assignment metadata like relevance scores and creation timestamps.

parameters.name: id_object
parameters.description: Required object identifier

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Required module name that owns the object

parameters.name: active_only
parameters.description: Whether to include only active tags (default true)

endp.mgtags.find.by.tags.short_descr: Find objects that have specific tags
endp.mgtags.find.by.tags.description: Searches for objects within a target module that are tagged with the specified tags. Can match objects that have 'any' or 'all' of the provided tags, and calculates affinity scores based on tag weights and relevance scores.

parameters.name: tag_slugs
parameters.description: Array of tag slugs to search for (min 1 required)

parameters.name: target_module
parameters.description: Module to search within

parameters.name: match_type
parameters.description: Whether to match 'any' or 'all' tags

parameters.name: min_affinity_score
parameters.description: Minimum affinity score for results (0+)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-100)

parameters.name: exclude_objects
parameters.description: Object IDs to exclude from results

parameters.name: active_tags_only
parameters.description: Whether to consider only active tags

endp.mgtags.find.by.affinity.short_descr: Find objects similar to a source object
endp.mgtags.find.by.affinity.description: Finds objects in the target module that share tags with the source object, calculating affinity scores based on shared tag relevance and weights. Useful for finding similar or related objects.

parameters.name: source_id_object
parameters.description: Source object ID to find similar objects for

parameters.name: source_module
parameters.description: Module containing the source object

parameters.name: target_module
parameters.description: Module to search for similar objects in

parameters.name: min_affinity_score
parameters.description: Minimum affinity score (0+, default 0.3)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-100, default 10)

parameters.name: exclude_objects
parameters.description: Object IDs to exclude from results

endp.mgtags.search.short_descr: Search tags by name, slug, or description
endp.mgtags.search.description: Performs a text search across tag names, slugs, and descriptions. Results can be filtered by category and active status, with pagination support.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional search query (searches name, slug, description)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional category filter

parameters.name: active_only
parameters.description: Whether to include only active tags

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-100, default 20)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Results offset for pagination (0+, default 0)

endp.mgtags.relevance.update.description: Modifies the relevance score for an existing tag-object relationship. The relevance score affects how the tag appears in searches and calculations.

parameters.name: tag_slug
parameters.description: Tag slug to identify the tag

parameters.name: id_object
parameters.description: Object identifier

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module name that owns the object

parameters.name: relevance
parameters.description: New relevance score (0-1)

endp.mgtags.stats.description: Provides detailed statistics about tag usage including total usage counts, average relevance scores, module breakdown, and auto vs manual tagging ratios.

parameters.name: tag_slug
parameters.description: Optional specific tag slug to get stats for

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional category filter

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Optional module filter

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description: Whether to include inactive tags

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-100, default 20)

endp.mgtags.bulk.add.short_descr: Add multiple tags to an object
endp.mgtags.bulk.add.description: Efficiently assigns multiple tags to a single object in a single operation. Can optionally overwrite existing tag assignments and provides detailed results about successes and failures.

parameters.name: tag_slugs
parameters.description: Array of tag slugs to add (min 1 required)

parameters.name: id_object
parameters.description: Object identifier

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module name that owns the object

parameters.name: relevance
parameters.description: Relevance score for all tags (0-1, default 1.0)

parameters.name: auto_tagged
parameters.description: Whether tags were auto-assigned

parameters.name: overwrite_existing
parameters.description: Whether to remove existing tags first

endp.mgtags.bulk.del.short_descr: Remove multiple tags from an object
endp.mgtags.bulk.del.description: Efficiently removes multiple tag assignments from a single object. Only removes tags that actually exist and are assigned to the object.

parameters.name: tag_slugs
parameters.description: Array of tag slugs to remove (min 1 required)

parameters.name: id_object
parameters.description: Object identifier

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module name that owns the object

endp.mgtags.list.by.module.short_descr: List objects in a module with tag information
endp.mgtags.list.by.module.description: Retrieves objects from a specific module along with their tag counts, average relevance scores, and tag lists. Useful for getting an overview of how objects in a module are tagged.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module name to search within

parameters.name: tag_slugs
parameters.description: Optional tag slugs to filter by

parameters.name: min_tag_count
parameters.description: Minimum number of tags an object must have

parameters.name: max_tag_count
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of tags an object can have

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-1000, default 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Results offset for pagination (0+, default 0)

endp.mgtags.merge.description: Consolidates two tags by moving all object assignments from the source tag to the target tag, then deactivating the source tag. Handles duplicate assignments gracefully by removing them instead of failing.

parameters.name: source_tag_slug
parameters.description: Tag slug to merge from (will be deactivated)

parameters.name: target_tag_slug
parameters.description: Tag slug to merge to (receives all assignments)

evt.tags.list_by_objects.name: tags.call.list_by_objects
evt.tags.list_by_objects.description: List the active tags of many objects at once (callable by other modules). Payload: { module: string, ids: string[] }. Returns { tags: Record<string, Tag[]> }, one entry per requested id (empty array when the object has no active tags)

evt.tags.find_objects_by_tag.name: tags.call.find_objects_by_tag
evt.tags.find_objects_by_tag.description: Find the objects of a module carrying an active tag (callable by other modules). Payload: { module: string, tag_slug: string }. Returns { ids: string[] }. Tags are not domain scoped: callers MUST intersect the ids with their own domain-filtered rows

evt.tags.tag_add.name: tags.call.tag_add
evt.tags.tag_add.description: Callable by other modules: forwards the payload (same params as tag_add) to the tag_add method and returns its response untouched

evt.tags.obj_add.name: tags.call.obj_add
evt.tags.obj_add.description: Callable by other modules: forwards the payload (same params as tag_object) to the tag_object method and returns its response untouched

evt.tags.obj_del.name: tags.call.obj_del
evt.tags.obj_del.description: Callable by other modules: forwards the payload (same params as tag_remove_object) to the tag_remove_object method and returns its response untouched
